Claim number:
C-1199

2024-11-19
Claim received by phone from the claimant, who reports being rear-ended... no wait, this is a head-on collision.
Reviewing the first notice of loss: low-speed head-on collision, claimant reports neck pain and stiffness and has no
lawyer representing them at this stage.
2024-12-17
Photos taken at the scene by the claimant show the front-end damage and confirm several details of how the vehicles
came together. No independent witnesses have come forward, so the photos are the main visual record for now.
2025-02-01
Police report obtained and it confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The responding
officer's notes are consistent with the account given at first notice.
2025-03-06
Vehicle inspected. The damage is motsly in line with the impact described, and the pattern of deformation fits a
low-speed frontal collision. Nothing in the inspection points to earlier damage on this vehicle.
2025-04-07
Checked prior claims and medical history. No earlier injury to the same body area is on record. The reported whiplash
is a good match for the kind and force of this crash.
2025-04-26
Coverage confirmed to be active on the date of loss, with no sign the damage predates the start of the policy. The
driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
2025-04-29
Spoke with the claimant again. The account has been the same in every conversation so far. Treatment has run
somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, so the medical records are being reviewed.
2025-05-23
Next steps are to request the full treatment records and continue the medical review. The file remains open pending
thsoe records.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
